name: dfma-review
description: DFMA Review root checks (S8b: Python retired). The web app, its tests and its Playwright e2e tests live in web/.

scripts.check: npm run drift && npm run nist && npm --prefix web run check && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix web run build:pages:test && node scripts/scope.mjs skip-if-ui -- npm run parity && npm run e2e && node scripts/scope.mjs skip-if-ui -- npm --prefix web run timed && npm run timed:e2e
scripts.timed: npm --prefix web run timed && npm --prefix web run e2e -- --grep @timed --workers 1
